title: Nouns and Verbs in Action
description: Identify naming, action, and describing words; match verbs to one or many; explore verb time; and write sentences from a picture.
learningFocus: Identify common and proper nouns and use possessive nouns to show ownership (L.1.1(b)).
Use singular and plural nouns with matching verbs (L.1.1(c)).
Use frequently occurring verbs to express past, present, and future time (L.1.1(e)).
Use frequently occurring adjectives to describe people, places, and things (L.1.1(f)).
adultGuidance: Nouns name a person, place, or thing. Verbs tell what happens. Help your child spot the naming word and the action word in a sentence. Ask when it happened, and add a word that tells what it is like. Let your child build a sentence, then write two of their own about the picture.
